description: Calculate the recommended inverter size for running AC loads from a DC battery system. Accounts for continuous power, startup surge power (motors typically surge 2-3x), and includes a 25% headroom for the continuous rating. Returns the recommended inverter wattage and the DC current draw at system voltage.

loads.description: List of AC loads that will run through the inverter

name.description: Name of the AC load (e.g. "Microwave", "Coffee Machine")

surgeWatts.description: Startup surge power in watts (for motors, compressors). If omitted, assumed equal to continuous watts.

name: calculate_inverter_size
title: Inverter Sizing Calculator
